one_line_description: Amazon Selling Partner API for third-party sellers and vendors to manage orders, inventory, and listings.

authentication.other: AWS Signature v4 signing + Login with Amazon (LWA) OAuth2 tokens

credential_access.notes: Requires an active Amazon Professional Selling account ($39.99/mo) and submitting a developer registration profile for security approval.

mcp.notes: Composio provides Amazon Selling Partner toolkit; community MCP implementations exist.

buildability.blocker: Enterprise sales or formal partnership contract required to obtain API keys
buildability.rationale: Developers cannot self-provision credentials; contractual approval from sales/BD is mandatory.

evidence.title: Connecting to the Amazon SP-API
evidence.excerpt: Calls to the Selling Partner API must be authenticated using Login with Amazon (LWA) access tokens and signed with AWS Signature Version 4.

verified_claims: MCP Classification (Official vs Vendor vs Community)
verification.notes: Verified by independent audit against official source: Requires Amazon Professional Seller plan ($39.99/mo) and formal developer profile vetting.
